visualCharacteristics.purpose: Single rounded card split side by side into a text panel (heading, copy, CTA) and an image panel
visualCharacteristics.description: Side-by-side layout of a text panel and an image in one card.

contentPattern.structure: One row with two cells: text cell (H2, paragraph, CTA link) and image cell. Either order works; on mobile the image always stacks under the text

cells: H2 'Modernize your content supply chain with Adobe GenStudio.'; paragraph 'Turn content into a growth engine for your business with Adobe GenStudio, an integrated, AI-powered content supply chain solution. ...'; link 'Learn about Adobe GenStudio' to /products/genstudio.html (filled black button)

usage: Use for a product or solution promo card placed at the end of a page section, with a heading, a paragraph, one CTA and a supporting image.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any two-panel promo card. Use columns-promo for the closing consultation banner and columns-media for unboxed media/text rows.
